THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF THE CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR FILED BY THE RESPONDENT AUTHORITY I FIR NO.RC0372022A0014 ALONG WITH THE COMPLAINT THEREON, FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 120 R/W 420,406 OF IPC AND SEC.13(2) R/W 13(1)(d) OF PC ACT PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE LEARNED XXXII ADDL.
CITY CIVIL
AND SESSIONS JUDGE AND SPL. JUDGE FOR CBI CASES, BANGLAORE
(CCH- 34) VIDE ANNEXURE-A.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This Court on 18.06.2024 had passed a peremptory order, which reads as follows:
"Two weeks time is granted to comply with the office objections, failing which, the matter would be dismissed without reference to the Bench."
Even today, there is no representation for the petitioners and the office objections are not complied.
Therefore, the petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.
